title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin closed the US session down 1.6 percent at sixty-four thousand fifty-one dollars, with fear and greed locked at twenty-seven. Network strength holds firm as hashrate sits at nine hundred seventy-three exahashes per second. Mempool carries eighty-seven thousand transactions with fees bottomed at three satoshis per byte. Block height advanced to nine hundred fifty-nine thousand four hundred ninety. Overnight focus stays on volume pickup and any sentiment reversal before the weekend open.
